QuestInfo.name: Francois in Need of Help
QuestInfo.0: It looks like #p303#, the tailor of #m10002000#, could use some help. Maybe I should stop by after a while.
QuestInfo.1: #p303#, the tailor of #m10002000#, received an important request, but he's been struggling due to a lack of materials. I need to defeat #r#o13#s#k and craft #b10 #t4003007##k to help him out.
QuestInfo.2: I was able to safely deliver the item #p303# asked for. At this point, I'd say I've proven myself to be a pretty solid apprentice.

0.0: Perfect timing. #p313# of #m10002000# has requested a special item for village maintenance. I don't think I can finish it on my own in time. ...Would you help me?

yes.0: Much appreciated. I need to craft #t1082000#, but I'm short on #b#t4003007##k. Could you craft some for me? You probably thought #t1082000# don't suit fairies very well, didn't you? Hmph. Still, fairy hands are far more delicate than you think. And while you're at it, deal with some of the #r#o13#s#k around the village. They keep getting in the way whenever I go out to gather materials. I'll be waiting.

no.0: An apprentice refusing a master's request... Is that how things work in the human world?

1.0: Good. This is exactly what I needed. As expected, you really are my first human apprentice. Heh...

yes.0: Here. Take this #t2002009# as your reward. It should make training your tailoring skills a bit easier.
yes.1: But this is troublesome... I have a feeling #p313# will keep making requests like this. It seems I might be relying on your help more often. I'll call on you again next time.

mob.0: You haven't defeated all the monsters I mentioned, have you? What are you hesitating for?

item.0: You haven't gathered all the materials either. What's taking you so long?
